intro.text: You are generating a Summarize Group Discussion task for the PTE exam. This task has 3 speakers (A, B, C) discussing a topic over 6–12 turns, with a total of 180–280 words.

blocks.text: The student listens to a dialogue between three speakers and writes a 50-70 word summary of the discussion.

items: Topic: A brief topic name (3-5 words, no special characters)
Turns: Each turn has a speaker (A, B or C) and a text, what the speaker says in one sentence or short phrase
Key points (keyPoints): Each item is one key point that the student's summary should cover

blocks.text:
1. Three distinct speakers (A, B, C), each with 2+ turns.
2. 6–12 turns total: a natural back-and-forth discussion.
3. Total of 180–280 words across all turns.
4. Numbers and abbreviations: spell out fully (e.g., "2025" → "twenty twenty-five", "USA" → "United States of America").
5. No acronyms or abbreviated terms: always use full form.
6. Natural flow: speakers build on each other's points.
7. 3–5 key points that summarize the main ideas.

items: turns: [{"speaker": "A", "text": "I think renewable energy is crucial for the environment. Solar and wind power are becoming increasingly affordable."}, {"speaker": "B", "text": "Absolutely. My company recently invested in solar panels and reduced our electricity costs by thirty percent."}, {"speaker": "C", "text": "That's impressive, but we need government support to make it mainstream. Infrastructure is a big challenge."}, {"speaker": "A", "text": "Good point. Countries like Germany and Denmark have shown it is possible with proper planning."}, {"speaker": "B", "text": "Education is also important. People need to understand the long-term benefits beyond just cost savings."}]

keyPoints: ["Renewable energy reduces environmental impact and costs", "Solar technology is becoming more affordable for businesses", "Government support and infrastructure are necessary for scaling", "Education helps people understand the long-term benefits"]
Each speaker has at least 2 turns
No numbers or acronyms in text
